desc: This updated version of the boot knife features a double-edged blade with a non-reflective black-oxide finish. The blade is heat treated. The black-oxide coating provides additional blade protection. For a secure grip, the handle is glass-filled nylon with a textured rubber overmold. The Secret Agent has a dual-carry molded sheath with straps for leg carry as well as a belt clip for convenient belt carry. Comes with a lanyard hole. Discreet and concealable for tactical use and personal protection, the Secret Agent is also viable for a variety of utility purposes. Fixed blade. Double-edged spear point. Lanyard hole Molded dual-carry sheath with clip & leg straps. Steel: Stainless steel, black-oxide coating. Handle: Rubberized co-molded handle. Blade length: 4.4 in. (11.2 cm). Overall length: 8.7 in. (22.1 cm).
